packageRules.description: Update tsdown, @tsdown/css, rolldown and rolldown-plugin-dts together in one PR without the default release-age delay: tsdown pins a rolldown patch range, so bumping them separately splits the workspace onto two rolldown copies
Dependency updates to other package jsons than the root should always use the chore scope as they aren't published to npm
Private workspaces are never published, so their dependency updates are chore too

The shared preset uses fix(deps) for every pnpm catalog entry, but the catalog mostly holds tooling (vitest, @types/node, publint, ...) and updates to it must not trigger a changeset. Catalog entries that published packages use at runtime are set back to fix below
Catalog entries consumed as runtime dependencies or peerDependencies by published packages: keep fix(deps) so they get a changeset. Add new runtime catalog entries here
Never narrow the tsdown peer range: the shared preset widens peerDependencies, so in-range releases leave the range untouched instead of pinning consumers to an exact version
